title: Coast Guard Rescues Two From Sinking Boat on Lake Erie
description:
An aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Detroit, aboard a Dolphin helicopter, rescued two men in Conneaut, Ohio, after the boat they were aboard began taking on water in Lake Erie, Oct. 29, 2014.

Both men were safely hoisted aboard the helicopter and taken to Erie International Airport in Erie, Pennsylvania.

U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Detroit
